text: Yes, and landed: design-tool-interface, at the step on errors, now says that an adapter that starts an engine and waits for it waits through the helper the template names under engine_wait in TEMPLATE.json, that its contract declares the errors that helper returns for a stopped run, and that the builder refuses an adapter that waits another way. specify-and-build is left as it is; the interface is where an adapter is designed.
